summary: Roberto Espinoza, 68, of Pharr, Texas, drowned at Lake Pueblo after leaving his boat to retrieve a toy float and disappearing below the surface; CPW rangers notified ~4:30 p.m. near the Sailboard area across from the South Marina (~7-ft water, ~2-ft visibility); PCSO volunteer dive team assisted CPW rangers with grid-search/dive operations; body located ~9 p.m. ~40 ft from shore via underwater remotely operated device; not wearing a life jacket; pronounced dead at scene; identified by the Pueblo County Coroner June 29
location: Sailboard area, Lake Pueblo State Park
responding_agency: Pueblo County Sheriff's Office volunteer dive team; Colorado Parks and Wildlife rangers
notes: Date pinned from incident-date references in the article; CPW press-release origin. Inserted run 548 (Pueblo County SO rotation chunk).
